scope: Private inventory-versus-holster transition instrumentation, same69NPC-owned command and dual-query-control path. Each snapshot distinguishes plan/rifle equipped flags, holstered flags, rifle firing and whether plan parent inventory still matches its lock scope. Four native event subscriptions canceled when each normal sampling wrapper exits. Callback snapshots may observe event ordering/transient transaction state and are separated from post-suspension polls; none proves rendered pose. Keep explicit plan-unequip/rifle-equip rejection controls, unlock before16rifle samples per cycle and actual held-tool cleanup/original2restoration/repeat. Native weapon stats unchanged; no Idle/Focus/parking during tool hold, forced attack primer, direct damage, explicit BeginFire, measured-phase teleports, player state changes or computer input. Query guards remain default off in main, enabled only private fixture. This is diagnosis, not a new retention fix or native build/edit/pro/publication acceptance.
